dialogue.content: こんばんは、相談員です
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: It's my pleasure.

dialogue.content: 夫のことで、悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm troubled about my husband.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのどのようなことでお悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What specifically about your husband is troubling you?

dialogue.content: 離婚したいと言われました
dialogue.English: He told me he wants a divorce.

dialogue.content: それはショックですよね
dialogue.English: That must be a shock.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どんなきっかけでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What brought that on?

dialogue.content: 困っています
dialogue.English: I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: 妊娠初期に、離婚したいと言われました
dialogue.English: He told me he wants a divorce in the early stages of my pregnancy.

dialogue.content: 妊娠がわかってからです
dialogue.English: It was after we found out about the pregnancy.

dialogue.content: そんな時期に言われたら余計に動揺してしまいますよね
dialogue.English: To be told that at such a time must be especially upsetting.

dialogue.content: それは酷いですね
dialogue.English: That's terrible.

dialogue.content: 腹が立ちます
dialogue.English: I'm so angry.

dialogue.content: そうですよね妊娠した途端にそんなことを言われたら腹が立つのは当然です
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It's only natural to be angry when he says something like that right after you got pregnant.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはどんな理由でそんなことを言っているのですか？
dialogue.English: What reasons has he given for saying that?

dialogue.content: 一人になりたい、独身に戻りたい、結婚生活は、これじゃないと思う、と。
dialogue.English: He says he wants to be alone, to go back to being single, and that this isn't the married life he imagined.

dialogue.content: いまさらそんなことを言われてもね呆れてしまいますね
dialogue.English: For him to say something like that now... it's just astounding, isn't it?

dialogue.content: （今入り直しました）
dialogue.English: (I've just reconnected.)

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみにあなたの年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: By the way, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: ２６才、女性です美智子でお願いします
dialogue.English: I'm 26 years old, female. Please call me Michiko.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 夫さんとはどんな経緯で結婚されましたか？
dialogue.English: How did you and your husband come to get married?

dialogue.content: 学生時代から付き合っていて、仲が良かったです
dialogue.English: We had been dating since our student days and got along well.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねということは数年間お付き合いをされてきたのですね？
dialogue.English: I see. So you were dating for several years?

dialogue.content: はい、結婚して、１年半になります
dialogue.English: Yes, we've been married for a year and a half.

dialogue.content: まだまだ新婚に近いのにあんまりですよね
dialogue.English: You're still practically newlyweds. That's just too much.

dialogue.content: 夫さんはどんな方なのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of person is your husband?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 人当たりがよく、私の友人とも話をしたり、私の家族からも、可愛がられていました
dialogue.English: He's personable, talks with my friends, and my family adored him.

dialogue.content: そうですか外交的な人なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, he's quite outgoing.

dialogue.content: ガールフレンドとか沢山いそうですか？
dialogue.English: Does he seem like the type to have a lot of female friends?

dialogue.content: そうなのかは、よくわかりませんが、そういう感じです
dialogue.English: I'm not sure if that's the case, but he gives off that impression.

dialogue.content: それは、よくわかりません
dialogue.English: I'm not really sure about that.

dialogue.content: そうですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫さんは、結婚生活はこれじゃないと言っていますが、
dialogue.English: You mentioned your husband said this isn't the married life he wanted,

dialogue.content: それなら、どんな結婚生活を考えていたのか聞かれてみかしたか？
dialogue.English: Have you asked him what kind of married life he had in mind?

dialogue.content: 結婚前に、いろいろ話をしました
dialogue.English: Before we got married, we talked about many things.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いつか、子供ほしい、家を買うのも良い、９ヶ月前には、一緒に家を買いました
dialogue.English: That we'd want children someday, that it would be nice to buy a house... we even bought a house together nine months ago.

dialogue.content: それなのに何故？って思いますよね
dialogue.English: So it makes you wonder, "Why?" doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, exactly.

dialogue.content: （2回目入り直しでした）
dialogue.English: (I've reconnected for the second time.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それで、独身に戻ってどうしたいと言っているんですか？
dialogue.English: And what does he say he wants to do if he becomes single again?

dialogue.content: よく聞いてみると、
dialogue.English: When I asked for more details,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 最近、職場の女子大生を好きになっていた時期があり、それが原因なのかな・・・。よくわかりません
dialogue.English: There was a time recently when he had a crush on a female college student at his workplace, so maybe that's the reason... I'm not sure.

dialogue.content: それは気になりますよね
dialogue.English: That would certainly make you wonder, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、今までの夫からは、考えられません
dialogue.English: Yes, I can't imagine the husband I knew doing that.

dialogue.content: まだ、信じられない
dialogue.English: I still can't believe it.

dialogue.content: それを確認することってできそうですか？
dialogue.English: Do you think you could confirm that?

dialogue.content: 無理かもしれません
dialogue.English: It might be impossible.

dialogue.content: そうですか・・・もどかしいですね
dialogue.English: I see... that must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここは、夫さんの本心を知りたいところですよね？
dialogue.English: You really want to know what your husband is truly thinking, don't you?

dialogue.content: これじゃないという理由だけで、すべてを諦めなければならないのでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do I really have to give up everything just because he says, 'This isn't it'?

dialogue.content: そうだとしたら、本当に理不尽なことだと思います
dialogue.English: If that were the case, I agree it would be completely unreasonable.

dialogue.content: ちょっと違います
dialogue.English: That's not quite it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: Oh, I see.

dialogue.content: 夫の理由より、私がどうして行ったほうが良いかが問題です
dialogue.English: The problem is more about what I should do, rather than my husband's reasons.

dialogue.content: でも、
dialogue.English: But...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 夫の本心は、それは、知りたいとは思いますが
dialogue.English: I do want to know what he's really thinking, though.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては、どうしたいと思っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: As for you, what would you like to do?

dialogue.content: 母にも相談しました
dialogue.English: I also talked to my mother.

dialogue.content: お母様はどんなことを言っていましたか？
dialogue.English: What did your mother say?

dialogue.content: 一人で産むのは、絶対に許さないと、言われました
dialogue.English: She told me she would never allow me to have the baby alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねそう言われてあなたはどう思いましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. And how did you feel when she said that?

dialogue.content: 私は、離婚して、生んであげられなかったら、一生後悔するのではないかと、思います
dialogue.English: I think if we get divorced and I can't have this baby, I'll regret it for the rest of my life.

dialogue.content: 夫に、何と言っても、もうだめなんでしょうか
dialogue.English: No matter what I say to my husband, is it already hopeless?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Well...

dialogue.content: え、だめなんですか
dialogue.English: What, so it is hopeless?

dialogue.content: やっぱり・・
dialogue.English: I knew it...

dialogue.content: いやそういう意味ではなくて
dialogue.English: No, that's not what I meant.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Oh, okay.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: 答えを探していました
dialogue.English: I was just searching for the right words.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 誤解を与えてしまって済みませんでした
dialogue.English: I'm sorry if I gave you the wrong impression.

dialogue.content: いいえ、気にしないでください、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: No, please don't worry about it, it's fine.

dialogue.content: 夫さんのことをまだよく分かっていないので、だめかどうかもお答えできなくて...
dialogue.English: I don't know your husband well enough yet, so I can't say whether it's hopeless or not...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: それを確かめるためにも、もう一度夫さんとじっくり話し合われてはと思ったのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: To find that out, I was thinking it might be good to have another in-depth conversation with your husband. What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい、話せるでしょうか
dialogue.English: Yes... I wonder if we can talk.

dialogue.content: 不安です
dialogue.English: I'm anxious.

dialogue.content: 私は、一体どうなるか、不安です
dialogue.English: I'm anxious about what's going to happen to me.

dialogue.content: あなたと夫さんの共通の知人の方で相談できそうな人はいらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Is there a mutual acquaintance of you and your husband that you could talk to?

dialogue.content: 友達に相談できないし
dialogue.English: I can't talk to my friends...

dialogue.content: そうなんですか
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 母に相談してもだめだし・・困っています
dialogue.English: And talking to my mother is no good either... I'm at a loss.

dialogue.content: 夫さんと話せるかどうかご不安になるのは、どんなところからですか？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel anxious about whether you can talk with your husband?

dialogue.content: 夫のことが、よくわからなくなってしまいました
dialogue.English: I just don't understand my husband anymore.

dialogue.content: 今までの夫からは、考えられません
dialogue.English: I can't imagine the husband I knew doing this.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね夫さんのこともよくわからなくなり、赤ちゃんをお腹に抱えて、相談する相手もいないのほ途方に暮れてしまうことと思います
dialogue.English: I understand. Not knowing what your husband is thinking, carrying his baby, and having no one to talk to... I can imagine you must feel completely lost.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly it.

dialogue.content: これまでのお話を整理させていただいてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: May I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: あなたは学生時代から付き合っていた人と結婚して1年半が経つ
dialogue.English: You've been married for a year and a half to someone you dated since your student days.

dialogue.content: まだ妊娠初期だが、夫さんから離婚したいと言われて戸惑っていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: You are still in the early stages of pregnancy, and your husband has told you he wants a divorce, leaving you feeling bewildered.

dialogue.content: 夫さんから結婚は何か違う、独身に戻りたいと言われて、夫さんのことがわからなくなってしまった
dialogue.English: Your husband has told you that marriage is not what he thought it would be and that he wants to be single again, which has made you feel like you don't understand him anymore.

dialogue.content: あなたとしては離婚したくないが、夫さんとじっくり話し合うのは不安になっていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: You don't want a divorce, but you're feeling anxious about having an in-depth conversation with your husband.

dialogue.content: 友人には相談できないし、お母様に相談しても子どもを産むのは赦さない言われる
dialogue.English: You can't talk to your friends, and when you talked to your mother, she told you she wouldn't allow you to have the child.

dialogue.content: もし離婚せざるを得ない場合には、子どもを産んで育てたいが、どうしたらいいのか解らなくなっていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: If divorce is unavoidable, you want to have and raise the child, but you don't know what to do.

dialogue.content: といいうことでしょうか
dialogue.English: Is that a fair summary?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: （時間が過ぎてしまいましたが、大丈夫ですか？）
dialogue.English: (We're over time—are you okay to continue?)

dialogue.content: 私は、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm fine with that.

dialogue.content: （それではもう少し続けさせていただきます）
dialogue.English: (Alright, let's continue for a little longer then.)

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: あなたがどうしていいのかわからずに、途方に暮れている気持ちが伝わってきました
dialogue.English: I can sense how lost you feel, not knowing what to do.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 本当に悩ましいことと思います
dialogue.English: I imagine this is truly distressing.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 状況をもう少し整理しますと、
dialogue.English: To organize the situation a bit more,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: まず、離婚しなければならないかどうか、ということで迷われています
dialogue.English: First, you're uncertain about whether you have to get a divorce.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 子供もです
dialogue.English: And about the baby as well.

dialogue.content: そして、もし離婚しなければなかなかった場合に、お子さんを産んで一人で育てていくのか、それとも産むことを諦めるのかということでも悩まれています
dialogue.English: And, if you do have to get a divorce, you're also struggling with whether to have the child and raise it on your own, or to give up on having the child.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一つのことでも悩ましいことなのに、二つのことを同時に悩まれていると、余計に頭が混乱してしまうように思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Either one of those is difficult enough to worry about, but when you're worrying about both at the same time, it seems like it would make your head spin even more. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it does.

dialogue.content: 悲しいです、苦しいです
dialogue.English: I'm sad, and it's painful.

dialogue.content: そこで提案したいことがあるのですが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I make a suggestion?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 夫さんがどうしても離婚しなければ納得しないのかどうかは、すぐには確かめられそうにはないとのことでしたよね？
dialogue.English: You mentioned it doesn't seem easy to confirm right away whether your husband absolutely insists on a divorce, right?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: だとすると、まずは離婚せざるを得なかった場合に備えて、お子さんを産むかどうかの方針を決めておくというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In that case, how about first deciding on whether to have the child, in preparation for if divorce becomes unavoidable?

dialogue.content: そうですか・・でも、母を無視して、産むのは、と思いまして・・。
dialogue.English: I see... but the thought of going against my mother's wishes to have the baby...

dialogue.content: それに、もう、離婚しなければいけないと決めてしまうのは、嫌です
dialogue.English: Also, I don't like deciding that divorce is inevitable already.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 中々難しい問題ですね
dialogue.English: It's quite a difficult issue.

dialogue.content: はい、そう思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: 解決までまだお時間がかかりそうですので、今日のご相談はここまでにして、よろしかったらまたお話にきてください
dialogue.English: It seems like it will take some time to resolve this, so let's end our session here for today. If you'd like, please come and talk again.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 今日は遅くまでどうもありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for your time today.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、ありがとうございましたお疲れ様でした
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: 不備な点、聞いて欲しかったこと、落としどころなどご指摘いただければ幸いです。
dialogue.English: I would appreciate it if you could point out any shortcomings, things you wished I had asked, or where you hoped the conversation would lead.

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 書きますので、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: I will write it down. Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは終了といたします。
dialogue.English: Then we will now conclude the session.

dialogue.content: 終了ボタンを押していただけますか
dialogue.English: Could you please press the end button?
